statement: There is an actual continuous peripheral automorphism with multiplier1 on the entire relative pronilpotent completion of N=ker(B to Q), whose full relative pro2 component is induced by an actual Galois commutator h and whose every odd relative-prime component is identity. Its G6 shadow has the prescribed extra CM pair T4=I,W3=[i]. The whole pro2 action has identity sphere projection and the compact elliptic unit eta*=(1-2zeta3^2)/(1-2zeta3), giving the retained Tate16 block; its actual rank4 source lift solves the full mixed-commutator lifting step for this replacement. Coprime centralizer lifts produce compatible normalized conjugators, but the CM bits are recovered invariantly from the new G2/G3 action via D25.6. The reconstructed parameter is exactly(f_h,2,1,...) with an actual Fhat-prime preimage; it is invisible in every pure pro-p completion of F yet nontrivial in this relative source. All projection kernels are given, and the remaining full-source kernel maps exactly onto A7 under an explicit S7 marking. The used relative centralizer coordinates do not lift to the corresponding full Bhat centralizers.
